How a Custom Jersey Order Works

1. Send what you have. A logo, a sketch, a photo of last season's kit, or nothing but colours and a sport. We work from whatever exists - there is no charge for a tech pack.

2. Design mockup in 24-48 hours. You get a front-and-back visual of the actual garment in your colours, with names and numbers laid out. Revisions are free until it is right.

3. Sample in 5-7 business days. One physical garment, made on the production line, shipped to you. You approve the fit, fabric and colour before anything is cut in bulk.

4. Production in 2-3 weeks. Cut, sublimated or embroidered, sewn and inspected at four stages with photo documentation.

5. DDP delivery in 3-7 days. Door to door by DHL or FedEx with duties paid, so the quoted price is the landed price.

Sublimation, Embroidery or Screen Print?

MethodBest forDurabilityColour limit
Dye sublimationAll-over graphics, numbers, sponsor panels, gradientsPermanent - dyed into the fibre, cannot crack or peelUnlimited
EmbroideryCrests, chest logos, polos and capsPermanent - stitched threadUp to ~15 thread colours
Screen printBold logos on cotton, large simple runsGood - sits on top of the fabricBest under 6 colours
Heat transfer / DTFPhotographic detail, very small runsModerate - can crack over yearsUnlimited

Polyester team kit is almost always sublimated; cotton and polos are embroidered or screen printed. We advise per design at quote stage.

Why Teams Order Direct From the Factory

Most custom jerseys reach a team through two or three intermediaries - a local dealer, a distributor, and the factory that actually makes them. Each adds a margin and a delay, and none of them can change the fabric weight or the pattern if it is wrong.

Ordering direct removes those layers. You specify the garment, approve a physical sample, and deal with the people cutting the fabric. Minimums start at 15-20 sets for team sports, so a single squad can order without a distributor's volume commitment. Start with a trial order if you would rather test first.

Questions

How long does it take to produce custom uniforms?

Design mockup in 24-48 hours, physical sample in 5-7 business days, bulk production in 2-3 weeks, and express DDP delivery in 3-7 days. From artwork to delivered kit is typically 4-6 weeks including sample approval.

Can I get custom jerseys in 15 days?

Yes, on a rush schedule if you skip the physical sample and approve the digital mockup instead. Sublimated jerseys can be produced in 10-12 days and shipped express in 3-5. Tell us your deadline in the enquiry and we will confirm before you commit.

How do I design custom sports uniforms?

Send whatever you have - a logo, a rough sketch, a photo of last season's kit, or just your colours and sport. Our designers build the tech pack and return a front-and-back mockup within 48 hours at no charge, and revisions are free until you approve it.

What is the minimum order for custom jerseys?

15-20 sets for team sports, which covers one squad with spares, and 20 pieces for individual garments. Sizes mix freely in the same order, and a 20-piece trial run is available before committing to a full order.

How much do custom jerseys cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours. Our published pricing page lists sublimated sports jerseys from $18.00 at 20 sets and full soccer kits from $20.00 at 15 sets, falling 10-40% at higher volumes.

Do you ship custom uniforms worldwide?

Yes - DDP delivery via DHL, FedEx and UPS to 30+ countries in 3-7 business days. DDP means duties are paid at our end, so the price we quote is the price you pay on delivery.
